content: For the issue in R1-2504573, RAN1 observed that RAN4 MAC-CE application timeline differs from that of RAN1 (k-Offset versus TA). Companies are encouraged to submit CRs to RAN1 and/or RAN4 upcoming WG meetings on whether and how to align RAN1 and RAN4 specifications.

For Text Proposal 1, if timeDurationForQCL is not applicable, UE ignores the condition with timeDurationForQCL.

For NW sided model for L1-RSRP report in L1 signaling, legacy quantization steps and range are reused.

For measurement report of AI/ML assisted positioning Case 3a, when timing information is reported from gNB to LMF,
From RAN1 perspective, LMF shall be able to distinguish whether the timing information is pre Rel-19 legacy timing measurement or Rel-19 Case 3a timing measurement.
It is up to RAN3 to decide how to ensure that LMF can distinguish between the two types of timing measurement.
RAN1 does not discuss the measurement gap occasion cancellation for concurrent measurement gaps further unless triggered by RAN4.
It can be discussed in UE feature session whether a dedicated PDSCH repetition capability (e.g. FG5-17a and FG16-2b-5) is a pre-requisite UE feature for Msg4 PDSCH repetition.
RAN1 will not specify enhancements for support of TBoMS with inter-slot OCC for PUSCH in Rel-19.
Additional SIB1-NB transmissions are supported based on current specifications without the need of indicating DL bitmap.
For TEI [SRSCS_ULTxSwitch], no new RRC parameters are introduced.

For the Rel-19 Type-I and Type-II (except for Type-II Doppler) codebook refinement for 48, 64, and 128 CSI-RS ports, when the K>1 aggregated NZP aperiodic CSI-RS resources for CMR are within two consecutive slots, following the legacy spec, the aperiodic triggering offset configured with the NZP CSI-RS resource set for interference measurement is the same as that of the associated NZP CSI-RS resource set for CMR.
For codebook-based PUSCH transmission by a 3TX UE, PUSCH scheduling by DCI format 0_3 is not supported.

When the UE transmits a PUCCH with HARQ-ACK information in slot n corresponding to the PDSCH carrying the MAC CE command updating PL offset of TCI state(s), the updated PL offset(s) shall be applied starting from the first slot that is after [EQUATION] where μ is the SCS configuration for the PUCCH.
contentWithEquations: When the UE transmits a PUCCH with HARQ-ACK information in slot n corresponding to the PDSCH carrying the MAC CE command updating PL offset of TCI state(s), the updated PL offset(s) shall be applied starting from the first slot that is after $n + 3N_{\text{slot}}^{\text{subrfame},\ \ \mu}$ where μ is the SCS configuration for the PUCCH.

content: Separate configuration of PCMAX/p-max is a RAN4 issue and will not be discussed in RAN1. It is up to RAN4 make decision on this issue. As part of RAN1 study on this issue, one company submitted simulation results in R1-2504391.

There is no RAN1 consensus to support separate initial UL BWP for SBFD-aware UEs. Reuse the legacy rule for determining the frequency domain resource allocation for Msg3 PUSCH transmission in SBFD symbols.
CLI reference resource is not introduced for L1 UE-to-UE CLI measurement and reporting
The other steps (in addition to agreed Step 1 and Step 5) for R2D waveform generation will not be described in the RAN1 TS.

For a cell supporting on-demand SSB SCell operation,
LTM based on OD-SSB is NOT supported in Rel-19.
L1 measurement based on OD-SSB for a serving cell in Scenario #2 is NOT supported in Rel-19.
On whether/how to indicate additional information related to SSBs associated with PDCCH monitoring occasions, no additional information is provided.
Using DCI 1_0 with P-RNTI to explicitly deactivate the additional PRACH resources is NOT supported.
There is no consensus in RAN1 whether to specify UE autonomous fallback to PDCCH monitoring when UE monitors LP-WUS in RRC CONNECTED mode.
Channel model for ISAC for SMa scenario will not be fully studied in Rel-19.
The component B2 of two different targets are generated independently.
Angular spread parameters for InF scenarios are not studied further due to lack of measurement data inputs.

From RAN1 perspective, there is no restriction with regards to the frequency location of CSI-RS used for CSI acquisition for candidate cells.
Send an LS to RAN4 (CC RAN2) and ask them to take the above conclusion in their further work.

For Rel-17 NCJT, aperiodic CSI-RS resources in a Resource Pair can only be configured within the same slot.
For Rel-18 CJT, aperiodic CSI-RS resources in a resource set can only be configured within the same slot.

For training data collection of AI/ML based positioning Case 3b, from RAN1 perspective, if the label data of location is generated by UE and transferred from UE to LMF, label and quality indicator of label can be provided by reusing existing IEs, legacy procedure, and legacy UE capability.
From RAN1 perspective, the existing IE can use one of the geographic shapes defined in TS 23.032. The location estimate uncertainty and confidence (if included with the geographic shapes) can serve as quality indicator of the label.

UE does not expect different values in ‘Measurement gap cancellation’ fields in DCI formats that are associated with the same measurement gap occasion and are received in same PDCCH monitoring occasion.
There is no consensus in RAN1 to introduce a restriction on the number of PRBs to support inter-slot OCC for PUSCH.

For the Rel-19 Type-II codebook refinement for 48, 64, and 128 CSI-RS ports based on the Rel-18 Type-II Doppler codebook, when the KDOPP >1 NZP aperiodic CSI-RS resource groups for CMR are configured, following the legacy spec, the aperiodic triggering offset configured with the NZP CSI-RS resource set for interference measurement is the same as that of the associated NZP CSI-RS resource set for CMR.
Regarding whether/how to reset the CLPC of PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS, no further additional enhancement in Rel-19.
There is no RAN1 consensus to support explicit indication of gNB transition period length and/or location between SBFD and non-SBFD symbols.

For RACH configuration Option 2, when a SBFD-aware UE switches from additional-ROs to legacy-ROs or from legacy-ROs to additional-ROs in PRACH transmission re-attempt in one RACH procedure, there is no RAN1 consensus to support a power offset to compensate the power ramping difference.

There is no consensus on the following:
Dedicated PRACH/SR resources can be configured for UE to report the beam failure caused by CLI.

For a cell supporting on-demand SSB SCell operation,
Whether or not to assume quasi co-location between different SSB indices is up to UE implementation

For the purpose of finalizing Rel-19 NES, RAN1 assumes the following UE behavior for OD-SIB1.
The SIB1 is transmitted on the DL-SCH with a periodicity of 160 ms and variable transmission repetition periodicity within 160 ms.
There is no consensus to support adaptation of RACH in time domain for 2-step RA in Rel-19.

From RAN1 perspective, for the case of potential collision (if any) in Option 1-2, when the UE is not able to monitor all the LP-WUS MO(s) in a LP-WUS periodicity,
It is up to RAN2 to further discuss and finalize the specification support, if any.
The component XPR/initial random phase of two different targets are generated independently.
No consensus to update RMa ASD and ZSD parameters due to lack of measurement data for each of LOS, NLOS, and O2I cases.

RRC configuration for time restriction is NOT introduced for CSI-RS based L1-RSRP measurement for either event triggered reporting or gNB scheduled reporting, i.e. it is up to RAN4 how many samples are used to define their requirement.

R1-2504884	Draft reply LS on differentiation of sDCI based mTRP and sTRP	CATT
Concern from a few companies to send such reply to RAN2, as there is no consensus in RAN1 on any of the alternatives. Finally, LS is approved in R1-2504885.

For model performance monitoring of AI/ML positioning Case 1, for model performance monitoring metric calculation in label-based model monitoring,
There is no consensus in RAN1 to support Option B (including Option B-1 and B-2).
Explicit configuration / indication of OCC enabler is not supported.
PUCCH repetition for Msg4 HARQ-ACK is not supported in SBFD random access procedure.
There is no RAN1 consensus to support RRC activation of OD-SSB transmission configuring od-ssb-nrofBurst.
There is no consensus on the support of OD-SIB1 for NR-U in Rel-19.
No further study on power normalization of target channel and background channel of ISAC channel in Rel-19

(following is deleted due to RAN1 agreement (Friday session) on how to introduce the updates of number of clusters)
No consensus to update the number of clusters for InH, UMi, and UMa.
It was observed that number of clusters reported (either from measurements and simulation) from Rel-14 SI and Rel-19 is smaller than what is specified in TR38.901. The number of cluster values were unchanged despite the observed measurement/simulated results due to concerns on impact to overall channel characteristics and applicability of observed measurement/simulated results to the cluster modeling in TR38.901.
There is no RAN1 consensus in Rel-19 to provide the UE with an indication of a subset of CSI-RS resources for CSI measurement before CSC.

RAN1 to confirm that the following rule from TS 38.133 is used to determine the TCI-state for a new BWP after a BWP switch:
‘Provided the UE does not have the required TCI-state information to receive PDCCH and PDSCH in the new BWP, the UE shall use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required TCI-state information for PDCCH and PDSCH is received after the BWP switch’.

For Rel-19 AI/ML based positioning, there is no consensus in RAN1 to introduce further enhancement to the existing phase measurement.
From the RAN1 perspective, LMF may use a measurement report from legacy method for carrier phase positioning in generating model input, based on LMF implementation.
There is no consensus in RAN1 to support separate msg3-DeltaPreamble parameters for non-SBFD symbols and SBFD-symbols for RACH configuration Option 2.

Other than RCS for human, vehicle, AGV, UAV, no other RCS for other objects is introduced in Rel-19.
Future studies are not precluded for adding RCS of other objects/sizes for modelling target or EO type-1, based on validation results from companies.
R1-2504165	Summary #5 on ISAC channel modelling	Moderator (Xiaomi)
From Friday session
There is no RAN1 consensus to introduce delay requirements based on Z and Z’.

It is common understanding that the ‘before reception of the activation command, …’ in the following paragraph of section 5.1.5 in TS 38.214 refers to ‘the activation command for any BWP’.
If tci-PresentInDCI is set to "enabled" for the CORESET scheduling the PDSCH, and the time offset between the reception of the DL DCI and the corresponding PDSCH is equal to or greater than timeDurationForQCL if applicable, after a UE receives an initial higher layer configuration of TCI states and before reception of  the activation command, the UE may assume that the DM-RS ports of PDSCH of a serving cell are quasi co-located with the SS/PBCH block determined in the initial access procedure with respect to 'QCL-TypeA', and when applicable, also with respect to'QCL-TypeD'.
No CR is needed.
Delete subsection 7.9.6 from the draft CR. For ISAC, no enhancement to existing TR38.901 LLS channel model is introduced in Rel-19.
No CPU is defined for LTM event triggered reporting.

For determination of the starting MO of PEI-O:
UE does not expect a configuration of firstPDCCH-MonitoringOccasionOfPEI-O indicating a MO which overlaps with uplink symbol or not aligned with the MO pattern configured by pei-SearchSpace;
There is no consensus to introduce an exact formula for micro-Doppler in Rel-19. The placeholder in the channel impulse response is kept in the draft CR.
For the LTM CSI acquisition after CSC until the completion of LTM procedure, CPU is not defined.
Companies are expected to bring contributions to RAN2 to fix the issue described in R1-2504787 in RAN2 specifications.

Definition of active CSI-RS resources after CSC until the completion of LTM procedure:
Active CSI-RS ports/resources for the candidate cells including target cell are not defined after CSC until the completion of LTM procedure.
For the LTM CSI measurement before CSC, CPU is not defined.

For the counting of active CSI-RS ports/resources before CSC, no new UE capability is introduced. The total number of active CSI-RS ports/resources is limited by legacy capability report. The total number of active CSI-RS ports/resources is shared by serving cell and candidate cell(s).
